The E7 Lead Pipeline

How Our Dispatch Engine Works

We handle all advertising and customer acquisition under our marketing umbrella. You simply receive qualified jobs ready for estimate.

01

Local Demand Generation

E7 Marketing launches targeted local ad campaigns capturing active homeowners searching for immediate service help in your area.

02

Lead Scrubbing & Verification

Our automated & staff verification system filters out tire-kickers, validating property location, job scope, and customer contact info.

03

First Right of Refusal

The lead is immediately sent to your business first. You have exclusive priority to accept or pass before anyone else sees it.

04

Zero Risk & Zero Exposure

Your brand name is never exposed in our ads. You get new revenue without ad spend risk or managing marketing campaigns.

The Zero-Risk Advantage

Compare standard marketing risk against Excursion Seven's exclusive first-right-of-refusal dispatch framework.

Traditional Ad Agencies & Shared Lead Brokers

  • Leads are resold to 4-6 competing local contractors simultaneously.
  • High upfront monthly retainers ($1,500 - $3,000/mo) with zero job guarantees.
  • Requires building expensive custom websites and managing complex ad accounts.
  • You waste time chasing stale numbers and unverified leads.
Contractor Preferred

Excursion Seven Marketing Group

  • First Right of Refusal: Every lead goes to the primary enrolled contractor first.

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything You Need to Know

Got questions about how priority dispatch works? Here are direct answers.

When a new lead is captured and verified in your designated zip code / territory, it is dispatched to your business first. You have a dedicated priority window to review the job details and accept or pass on the lead. It is never broadcast to multiple competitors at once.
No! That is one of the biggest benefits of partnering with Excursion Seven. We build and fund all customer-facing service campaigns under our proprietary brand assets. Your company name is not displayed in our ad spend, protecting your existing reputation while delivering ready jobs straight to your phone.
If your schedule is fully booked or a specific job doesn't fit your current capacity, you simply decline or let the right of refusal window elapse. The lead then safely rotates to a standby backup partner in the network. You retain your primary priority spot for future incoming leads!
We specialize primarily in high-intent residential trade and property maintenance services, including tree service/removal, lawn care & yard cleanup, gutter cleaning, window washing, pressure washing, and general home exterior repairs.
Simply fill out our brief Partner Application form below or contact our dispatch team directly. We will review your operating area, check for open territory slots, and set up your dispatch preferences.
